decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan 07.11.2025, Existing and Proposed Block Plan 25_1015_100 RevA 09.10.2025, Existing and Proposed Floor Plans 25_1015_101 RevA 09.10.2025, Existing and Proposed Elevations 25_1015_102 RevA 09.10.2025, Energy Statement 20.03.2025, Heritage Statement, Planning Statement, Highway safety Impact Form.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding condition 2, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than five residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Prior to first occupation of the HMO, Cycle parking, as indicated on drawing "Existing and Proposed Floor Plans 25_1015_101 RevA 09.10.2025", shall be provided within the site in accordance with the following requirements:o Provision of a minimum of FIVE long stay cycle parking spaces.o in an accessible location: the access route to the long stay store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike to enter the store, should involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store door) which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2m;o secured: with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob;o fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof.o the front boundary wall and gate shall not exceed 1m in height.Reason: To ensure the provision of accessible, secure, and adequate cycle parking facilities and to safeguard the character and appearance of the area.

No refuse storage containers or sacks shall be stored on Wilford Close except on refuse collection days as per the Council's published collection schedule. The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the occupiers of adjoining premises; protect the general environment; prevent any obstruction to pedestrian movement and to ensure that there are adequate facilities for the storage and recycling of recoverable materials.
description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C4 (HMO-house in multiple occupation) and creation of terrace on flat roof to the rear with associated fencing and cycle storage.
